metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for running App Store Connect and Google Play releases safely: every change is previewed, confirmed and audited.

plugins.name: hypercaffium-apple
plugins.description: Run an App Store release from Claude: release overview with pre-flight, release notes, builds, submit, phased release, screenshots, reviews, TestFlight, subscriptions and prices. Every change is previewed, confirmed and audited.

plugins.name: hypercaffium-play
plugins.description: Manage Google Play from Claude: release status, tracks and staged rollouts, listing text and images, review replies and subscriptions. Every change is previewed, confirmed and audited.

plugins.name: glue
plugins.description: The glue between the Apple and Google plugins: one-command cross-store release status and change monitoring, plus an optional background watcher.
